entries.german:
Die dem kurmainzischen Oberamtmann zu Königstein Johann Dietrich v. Rosenbach für seine bei der Tilly'schen Armada geleisteten Dienste überlassenen v. d. Hees'schen und v. Dietz'schen Güter in der Ganerbschaft Lindheim und das dazugehörige Dörfchen Hainchen, was alles dem kaiserlichen Fiscus verwirkt und heimgefallen, von den früheren Besitzern aber widerrechtlich der Grafschaft Hanau teils zu Mannlehen aufgetragen, teils heimlich verpfändet worden sei

Laufzeit: 1637-1644
entries.english:
The properties of the von d. Hees and von Dietz families in the Lindheim co-heir community and the associated hamlet of Hainchen, which had been transferred to Hans Dietrich von Rosenberg, chief bailiff of the Electorate of Mainz at Königstein, in recognition of his service in Tilly's army. All had been forfeited to and reverted to the imperial fisc, but their former owners had unlawfully assigned some as male fiefs to the County of Hanau and secretly mortgaged others.

Date span: 1637–1644.
